label: Security & Governance
seo_description: Role-based access, permission depth, audit trails, authentication discipline, backups, and multi-campus governance for school data worldwide.
headline: Secure, governed, and role-aware by design.
subheadline: Protect student and financial data with controls that scale from single schools to growing networks.

segments.title: Access control
segments.body: Role-based permissions with clear ownership for administrators, teachers, finance, and families.

segments.title: Auditability
segments.body: Trace sensitive operations for internal review and external assurance conversations.

segments.title: Operational resilience
segments.body: Backups and continuity practices appropriate to institutional data—confirm details during implementation.

extras.stock_photo_alt: Server room aesthetic representing secure infrastructure

problem_section.title: School data deserves disciplined stewardship
problem_section.body: Casual sharing and opaque admin history create risk. RunMyCampus emphasizes least-privilege access, meaningful logs, and governance patterns that multi-campus organizations can enforce.

bullets: Clear surface area for integrations and identity
Confidence in who can change financial or academic records
Operational trace—not a vague “we are secure” claim
Paths to document retention and access reviews
